title: 2026 F-gas and ODS charging/reporting QA controls

sources.title: Fluorinated greenhouse gases and ozone-depleting substances charging scheme

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Record and report ozone-depleting substances you import export sell or destroy

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency charging scheme covers fluorinated greenhouse-gas activities.
facts.expected_handling: Bind charges to the correct regulated activity.

facts.source_fact: The charging scheme also covers ozone-depleting-substance activities.
facts.expected_handling: Keep ODS and F-gas activity classes distinct.

facts.source_fact: Charges were updated from 1 April 2026 in line with the Consumer Prices Index increase.
facts.expected_handling: Use the 2026 charge vintage for 2026 activity.

facts.source_fact: Charges increase from 1 April 2027 and annually thereafter in line with the Consumer Prices Index mechanism stated by the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply future charge values before their effective date.

facts.source_fact: Regulatory charges are fees for activities and are not greenhouse-gas emission values.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent fee-to-emission inference.

facts.source_fact: ODS record and reporting requirements apply to relevant activities in Great Britain.
facts.expected_handling: Apply geographic scope before reporting checks.

facts.source_fact: Relevant businesses must record amounts of ozone-depleting substances imported.
facts.expected_handling: Track import quantities by substance and period.

facts.source_fact: Relevant businesses must record amounts of ozone-depleting substances exported.
facts.expected_handling: Track exports separately from imports.

facts.source_fact: Relevant businesses must record amounts of ozone-depleting substances sold.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve sale transaction provenance.

facts.source_fact: Businesses destroying ODS must record the quantity of each gas destroyed.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat destruction quantity as atmospheric release.

facts.source_fact: Records must also cover equipment containing ozone-depleting substances where applicable.
facts.expected_handling: Separate contained equipment from bulk-substance records.

facts.source_fact: ODS destruction records include the technology used to destroy the gases.
facts.expected_handling: Carry destruction-method provenance.

facts.source_fact: ODS destruction records include end-of-year stock held for destruction.
facts.expected_handling: Separate stock from destroyed quantity.

facts.source_fact: The annual ODS activity report is due by 31 March for the previous calendar year.
facts.expected_handling: Track reporting year and deadline.

facts.source_fact: Reporting uses the Great Britain ODS service and associated organisation account process.
facts.expected_handling: Carry account and submission provenance.

facts.source_fact: Businesses may use their own systems to keep required ODS records.
facts.expected_handling: Validate required fields rather than mandating an unsupported storage format.

facts.source_fact: A recorded destruction amount indicates controlled destruction activity, not an emission to air.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent destruction-to-emission inference.

facts.source_fact: ODS stock held at year end is inventory, not evidence of release.
facts.expected_handling: Keep stock balances distinct from emissions.

facts.source_fact: The charging guidance was updated on 19 May 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the current charging-scheme version date.

facts.source_fact: F-gas and ODS charging/reporting records operate at organisation and activity level, not parcel level.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent parcel-level inference.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve charge, stock, destruction and reporting semantics.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents regulatory records being misreported as emissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach gas class, organisation, GB scope and activity type.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing F-gas and ODS obligations.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach charge effective date and reporting year.
Carry transaction, destruction-method and submission provenance.
Do not convert regulatory records into parcel emissions.
